form.title: Repayment of the First-Time Homebuyer Credit

lines.caption: Enter the amount of the credit you repaid with your tax returns for the years 2010 through 2023
Amount of the credit to be repaid. See instructions

form.notes: TERMINATED FOR 2025. The current revision is Rev. November 2024 and its own line 8 instruction reads "Enter the amount from line 8 on your 2024 Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 10." On the 2025 Schedule 2, line 10 is "Reserved for future use", and irs-prior/f5405--2025.pdf returns 404. The 15-year repayment of the 2008 credit ran with the 2010 through 2024 returns, so TY2024 carried the final installment.
